title: A jazz fan first, a musician almost by accident
summary: He says he would have been an ardent jazz fan if he had not become a musician, never thought of music as a career and was easygoing compared with his ambitious brothers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
